FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Website Hosting?

Website hosting is like renting a parking space on the web so people can access your site. We offer commercial-grade hosting on dedicated servers with speed, performance, and reliability at competitive prices.

What is Website Maintenance?

We keep your WordPress software, plugins, and security patches up to date. Regular maintenance ensures your website operates securely and efficiently as new versions are released.

What is Website Support?

Whenever you need changes or updates to your website — from content edits to new features — our support team handles it quickly and professionally.

Do you offer uptime guarantees?

Yes. All our hosting plans include a 99% uptime guarantee. Our Enterprise plan includes a 99.9% SLA with priority emergency response.

Can I migrate my existing site?

Absolutely. We handle the full migration for free on all plans — including DNS transfer, database migration, and a 48-hour parallel run to ensure zero downtime.

Need Reliable Hosting & Maintenance?

Get peace of mind with our managed hosting plans. Free migration included — we handle everything.
